text:
Maria (Marketing): Quick sync — I'm pulling together the benchmark narrative for launch. Want to test 3 snapshot scenarios (SMB / Mid / Enterprise) and map them to inbound routing + a simple heatmap for comms. Need a one-pager + 2 visuals. Who can take what?

Aj (Design): Two visuals sounds right: scatter (latency vs unit cost) + stacked bar (percent requests on fastpath). Keep labels short. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Sophia (Growth): Agree. We also need a tight pressable line: 'Cut inference spend while keeping 99th pctl latency under X ms' — need concrete numbers per slice though.

Kevin (Bench): I'll run quick microbenches today. Tentative numbers from local runs: SMB (7B q4): p99 ~95ms, cost $0.0008/token; Mid: p99 ~120ms, $0.0015/token; Enterprise: p99 ~180ms, $0.003/token. Will validate under load.

Maria (Marketing): Nice. Also want inbound rule: lead_score > 80 => sales follow-up; else self-serve nurture. And add callouts for Dedicated/Private as separate points.

Aj (Design): For the scatter, annotate regions: fastpath (low latency, low cost), slowpath (higher latency), and an overlay for deployment mode colors (hosted/dedicated/private). Use log-scale on cost.

Sophia (Growth): Webinar CTA: 'See how we shave X% off token costs without sacrificing latency' — use that for email subject A/B. Also prep a 30s demo clip.

Nate (Ops): I'll produce a 2-slide methodology appendix: load profile, batching distribution, quant settings, measurement script. Quick snippet from the harness:```
# harness config
model: redwood-7b-q4
seq: 1024
batching: dynamic
prefix_cache: true
measurements: p50,p95,p99,cost_per_token
```

Kevin (Bench): Running now — pushing raw CSV to drive: https://drive.example/bench-3333.csv. Note: enterprise p99 rises ~15% under spike windows. See notes column.

Maria (Marketing): :thumbsup: Can someone mock the scatter in figma? Use color by deployment mode and annotate canary vs default.

Aj (Design): I'll draft a quick fig (~2 hrs). Using color palette from our brand kit. Link: https://figma.com/file/bench-figma/latency-cost-snapshot. Feedback welcome.

Sophia (Growth): Prepare short customer quote placeholder: 'We cut inference costs by 60% while keeping latency under 150ms.' Tag PMs for approval before publish.

Maria (Marketing): Tasking: Aj = visuals, Kevin = final validated numbers + CSV, Nate = methodology appendix, Sophia = webinar invite + messaging + quote approvals. I'll stitch into 1-pager and landing copy.

Kevin (Bench): CSV uploaded. Updated p99s: SMB 98ms, Mid 125ms, Enterprise 210ms under 95th percentile load. Costs roughly same +/- 5%. Added a notes.md in the drive.

Aj (Design): Draft fig uploaded to figma. Quick ask: keep axis title 'Latency (99th, ms)' and 'Unit cost (USD/token)'. Use dashed line at 150ms for our consumer SLA.

Sophia (Growth): A/B copy for email subject — vote: :one: 'Latency you can count on' vs :two: 'Latency + cost optimized'. Please react.

Nate (Ops): :two:

Kevin (Bench): :two:

Aj (Design): :two:

Sophia (Growth): :two:

Maria (Marketing): Second wins. Next steps: Aj + Kevin finalize assets by EOD tomorrow, Sophia drafts webinar invite and landing copy, Nate produces methodology appendix. Ping me when done and I'll assemble the launch one-pager + chart exports.

triage-bot: Reminder: webinar draft due in 2 days — <@Maria (Marketing)> set a reminder for 48h.

Maria (Marketing): Thanks all — will follow up with a small outline in the thread when I have the first draft.
